controls.negative: Across ALL train/validation/test cases, reject zero and oracle-assisted first-future constant forecasts with correct-law label; retain wrong-law and short-prefix challenges
controls.positive: Oracle-only perfect forecast+law passes only when held-out trajectory has informative variation; 26/27 nontrivial test cases pass, one is unidentifiable at fixed point

dependencies: Git CLI for immutable candidate revision
domain: Finite seeded synthetic sample times; no network, API, GPU, unbounded search or untrusted execution

aliasing.claim: period-four underlying process; observed values constant only due to aliasing
aliasing.definition: x(t)=(rep+2)*[1,0,-1,0][(t+rep) mod 4]; observed at t=4i, query at t=4(n-1)+1..h
aliasing.negative: zero-delta and persistence forecasts falsified by changed sample rate

constant.negative: constant prediction applied to every nonconstant family is invalid

geometric.claim: constant multiplicative recurrence at unit interval

logistic_chaos.claim: nonlinear logistic map (finite precision, no formal chaos proof)

nonlinear_modular.claim: nonlinear modular recurrence; finite differences not generally small-order constant

nonuniform_polynomial.negative: index-based differences cannot assume uniform sampling

periodic.negative: step-four aliasing cannot prove underlying process constant

polynomial.claim: lowest polynomial order 1/2/3 in physical time, not sample index
polynomial.definition: rep0: p+t; rep1: p+2t+3t²; rep2: p+3t+4t²+t³
polynomial.negative: short degree-3 interpolation of arbitrary data does not justify polynomial law

random_noise.negative: fit to observed prefix does not imply prediction

switching.negative: global low-order polynomial fits one regime but is not structural identification

hard_limitations: No OS-enforced sealed oracle or cryptographic hidden-evaluation service; trusted evaluation process must control module access.
Models can inspect public repository generator code if given filesystem access: source confidentiality is NOT guaranteed.
Fixed deterministic seeds can be memorized; use unpublished fresh generator seeds for live evaluation; this suite is a reproducible regression benchmark, not a secure competition.
No formal invariance or novelty proof, no learned model trained, no intervention causal identification, no independent reviewer approval yet.
No champion, model checkpoint, trainer service, or upstream artifacts touched.
oracle_target_commitment_method: SHA256 UTF-8 compact sorted-key JSON array of {case_id,reference_exact} entries in oracle.cases(split) order
parameter_note: p ranges are pairwise disjoint; finite phase/rate choices necessarily reuse modulo classes. Parameter range separation does not imply total generative independence.

precision.anti_collapse: At least one held-out reference component differs from first by more than twice ABS_TOL+REL_TOL*max(abs(a),abs(b)); otherwise only forecast_pass may be true
precision.exact: Fraction for every family except logistic_chaos
precision.failure: nonfinite numbers, wrong shape or horizon raise ValueError
precision.not_proved: No symbolic theorem follows from finite observations or approximate float64 outcomes
precision.pass_rule: every scalar component abs(pred - target) <= 1e-6 + 1e-8 * abs(target)
precision.public_observations: float64 values and reversible decimal-text/first-difference encodings

primary_question: Does a finite measured prefix support transferable invariants or recurrence laws rather than fit alone?
review_history: Prior independent_verification.json is a genuine FAIL for the older candidate; new manifest requires a new independent verification receipt.

scores.CPU: process CPU seconds measured in report; baseline implementation fixed and bounded
scores.bounded_discovery_pass: correct private law, every held-out forecast in tolerance, nontrivial deterministic family, and future reference variation above twice tolerance; still bounded empirical identification only
scores.causal_prediction: not established by observational replay; require intervention evidence separately
scores.extrapolation: bounded held-out numeric forecast pass rate and error
scores.fit: observed prefix fit; NOT a discovery
scores.invariance: No constant-output predictor earns discovery PASS; fixed-point horizons are forecast-correct but do not identify a generative law
scores.structural_identification: candidate names a law matching private oracle label; ordinary baselines do not claim one
scores.transfer: report train/val/test separately and train-heldout-family denominators; no guaranteed learned transfer

validation.periodic_stride_note: Use odd stride for period-four case to avoid full phase aliasing; dedicated aliasing family retains deliberate rate confound

split_protection: Candidate-facing views contain only past measured values and future query timestamps; private family labels, coefficients and future reference values remain within evaluator. Source code is available to a trusted local operator, so this is NOT tamper-resistant data secrecy.
